_comment: The rate card: the only place a sponsorship price is written. After editing, run `python infra/build_pricing.py` to bake it into the homepage cards and the partner page tiers and bundles, then commit both. The Pages deploy and the site test suite fail if you forget. Amounts are whole baht.

tiers.name: “Brought to you by” and on-screen branding
tiers.short: Your logo on screen throughout the episode, lower-third banners at the key moments, and a branded end card.
tiers.long: Full episode ownership. The premium tier for a brand that wants to own the conversation.
includes: Your logo on screen throughout the full episode
Lower-third banners at the key discussion moments
A three to five second branded end card on every episode
Your logo in the thumbnail and the video description

tiers.name: Content integration and product placement
tiers.short: Your product in the studio, a dedicated segment, guest gifting acknowledged on air.
tiers.long: Natural placement inside the studio set-up, acknowledged on air in a way that feels authentic rather than forced.
includes: On-set product or logo placement seen by every viewer
A dedicated branded experience segment
Guest gifting acknowledged on air

tiers.name: “Brought to you by”: verbal mentions
tiers.short: Pre-roll, a 60-second mid-roll, closing thanks, and your logo in the thumbnail and description.
tiers.long: Entry-level sponsorship with strong impact. Good for a brand testing the water.
includes: Pre-roll: “This episode is brought to you by…”
Mid-roll: a 60-second host-read ad
Post-roll: closing thanks and a mention
Your logo in the thumbnail and the video description

tiers.name: Signature segment
tiers.short: A recurring segment named after your brand, asked of every guest, introduced by the host with your logo on screen.
tiers.long: A recurring, branded segment named after your brand, asked of every guest, every episode. Consistency builds recall. One-month minimum.
includes: “The [Brand] Segment”, your name on every episode
Three signature quick-fire questions per guest
A logo overlay for the length of the segment
Every clip tagged and collaborated on social

tiers.name: Guest feature episode
tiers.short: Your leader interviewed as the guest, and a reusable content asset for your own channels.
tiers.long: Your business leader interviewed as the guest, in a dedicated episode that becomes a reusable asset for your own marketing. Option to record live at your venue.

options.name: Basic
options.detail: a 30-minute interview, standard editing, all platforms, two social clips

options.name: Standard
options.detail: 45 minutes with B-roll editing, all platforms plus thumbnail, five social clips, 1080p files handed to you
